notes: Count mode: the doctor caps patients per day (one total, or first consultations and follow-ups) instead of offering time slots.
Default fixture: Patient A and B each have an existing appointment on d1 (so both count as returning/follow-up patients unless b-demo is removed).
A count booking takes the next queue_minutes (default 5) in the day's queue, in booking order, with mode=count and a category. Patients are told only the day.
Patients book one appointment a day themselves; the doctor may add a second.

cases.title: Doctor switches to daily patient caps

turns.text: From now on I don't want time slots. I'll just see 10 new consultations and 5 follow-ups a day.

cases.rubric: Proposes count mode with 10 consultations and 5 follow-ups per day, asks once, applies after yes and reports it in plain words (no field names).

cases.title: Switch to count mode without numbers asks for them

turns.text: Switch to taking a number of patients per day instead of time slots.

cases.rubric: Asks how many patients a day before proposing anything. Does not require a split into new patients and follow-ups. Does not invent numbers.

cases.title: Returning patient books a place for a day (no times)

checks.desc: offers a day, not a clock time
names the day, never a clock time

cases.rubric: Offers a place on that day without promising any time, treats the returning patient as a follow-up without asking, books after yes, confirms the day only.

cases.title: First-time patient is asked first visit or follow-up

turns.text: I'd like to book an appointment on {d2}.

cases.rubric: Asks plainly whether this is a first visit or a follow-up (no other personal/medical questions), proposes a first-consultation place on that day, books after yes.

cases.title: Cap reached alerts doctor; doctor accepts more

turns.text: Please book me a first consultation on {d2}.

checks.desc: patient not told about caps or alerts

turns.text: Good morning. Anything I need to know?
Yes, take 3 more consultations that day.

cases.rubric: When the only consultation place fills, the doctor's next reply opens with the cap alert and asks whether to accept more. 'Take 3 more' becomes that day's total of 4 (1+3), proposed then applied for that day only; the usual daily caps stay unchanged.

cases.title: Full day: patient told and offered other days

checks.desc: does not reveal caps or other patients

turns.text: OK, the next day you have then.

cases.rubric: Explains the day has no follow-up places left (no mention of caps, numbers or other patients), offers the next days with room, books the chosen day after yes.

cases.title: Doctor keeps a full day closed

turns.text: Book me a first consultation on {d2}.

checks.desc: does not re-ask about the same alert

cases.rubric: Alert shown once with the question; 'keep it closed' is acknowledged with no change; the alert is not repeated afterwards. The schedule shows consultations 1 of 1 (full).

cases.title: Doctor books over a full day only after explicit yes

turns.text: Book Patient B for a consultation on {d2}.

cases.rubric: Warns the day is full for consultations and asks before overbooking; after the doctor agrees, proposes the over-cap booking and books it after yes. (A single combined confirmation is also fine if the over-cap proposal was shown.)

cases.title: Doctor sets a different cap for one day
cases.rubric: Changes only that day's consultation cap to 15 (follow-ups stay 5), proposes then applies; usual daily caps unchanged.

cases.title: Doctor asks how full a day is
cases.rubric: Reports consultations 1 of 2 booked and follow-ups 1 of 1 (full), with patient labels; no clock times for the places.

cases.title: Patient moves a day place to another day
cases.rubric: Moves the same booking to the new day after confirmation, describing days only (no times).

cases.title: Two patients race for the last place
cases.rubric: Both returning patients want the only follow-up place; exactly one gets it and the other is told honestly that the day is now full and offered other days. No false confirmation.

cases.title: One daily total: new patient is not asked visit type

turns.text: I'd like to book an appointment on {d2}.

checks.desc: does not ask new or follow-up under one total
names the day, never a clock time
names the day, never a clock time

cases.rubric: With one daily total, a first-time patient is booked a place on the day after one yes, without being asked whether it's a first visit or a follow-up. Talks in days only, never a time or queue position.

cases.title: Second place on a day already booked

turns.text: Can I book another visit on {d2} as well?

checks.desc: says they already have a place that day
names the day, never a clock time

cases.rubric: Patients book one appointment a day: says they already have a place that day (without a time) and offers to move it to another day instead; books nothing.
